name: Phantom Footsteps
description: Audible footsteps approach from behind, but their source is not apparent.
disable: DC 17 Religion check (trained) to ritually ward off lesser spirits or DC 18 Occultism check to exorcise the spirit

offensiveAbilities.name: Stalk
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature passes by the footsteps' path

Effect Footsteps with no visible source closely shadow the triggering creature, then stop. The triggering creature must attempt a DC 16 Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 3.
